name: SocialKit API
description: Unified REST API for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, and Reddit. Most scraping tools accept GET query parameters and POST JSON bodies; operation-specific contracts below are authoritative. See https://docs.socialkit.dev for guides and pricing.
